title: You Can Win the Presidency With 22% of the Vote
summary: A short CGP Grey animation showing how the US electoral college lets a candidate win the presidency with as little as about 22 percent of the popular vote. It lays out the arithmetic of winning states by narrow margins.
why: Linked in electoral-system discussions as a quick, clear argument against the electoral college.

quote.text: you can effectively become president if you can get the right 22% of the USA to vote for you.
